component.name: Z890 LCD Unleashed
component.summary: Control the ROG MAXIMUS Z890 EXTREME motherboard LCD

description.p: Linux replacement for the Armoury Crate LCD page: built-in wallpapers and animations, your own pictures, slideshows, a fully configurable hardware monitor fed by Linux sensors, brightness, sleep-mode display and a temperature warning.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by ASUS.
